data.title: Senior Education Professional, Development
data.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><span data-contrast="none">Senior Education Professional, Development (NiCE Systems, Inc; Atlanta, GA): Design and develop technical instructor-led training (ILT), virtual ILT, and eLearning content for company Analytics and Quality Central platforms. Own the end-to-end training lifecycle, including needs analysis, curriculum design, content development, validation, and delivery. Develop and maintain technical documentation, lab guides, and troubleshooting exercises to support hands-on learning. Ensure training materials remain accurate, up to date, and aligned with product releases and best practices. Partner with Product Management and R&amp;D to gain deep understanding of system architecture, new features, and release changes. Act as a global technical point of contact for trainers, providing product guidance, troubleshooting support, and enablement. Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain training lab environments, including servers, databases, and supporting services. Deliver technical training sessions to customers, partners, and internal employees as needed. Support trainer readiness by enabling instructors on new or updated course content. Manage multiple development initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced, release-driven environment. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to meet delivery timelines and quality standards.</span><span data.summary: The Senior Education Professional, Development designs, develops, validates, and delivers technical instructor-led, virtual, and eLearning content for NiCE Analytics and Quality Central platforms. The role manages the full training lifecycle, maintains technical documentation and lab environments, supports trainers globally, and collaborates with Product Management, R&D, and other stakeholders on product releases and enablement.
